review_description: Good service, took care of all project managements, answered all our many questions. Installation was on schedule and very happy with the outcome. Electrified the whole house and got rid of gas.

I would recommend Specialized Solar as they were very professional and knowledgeable. The person I was dealing with was always willing to help and answer any questions I had. The installation and grid connection/approval was very well managed. We are now enjoying the benefits of the solar panels and battery.
Very easy to deal with and provide quality equipment.Very good level of detailed information during the quoting process

We decided to extend our current 6 kw SolarEdge system but adding a battery, after quotations and research we chose to use a SolarEdge Battery, once that was decided the installers advised we could add additional panels under this agreement, which everybody else wouldn't do. Installation hasn't commenced yet because of delays obtaining the Vic Solar Loan, and waiting for an onsite inspection. Overall the experience has been good from Specialised Solar
Very quick and pleasant and a great job. Hardest part was completing the solar rebate form on line forvic Gov.

Specialised Solar gave us a great sales process and steered us through organising the government solar grant paperwork and the installation process very professionally.The grid connection was organised with our retailer, it is only the retailer holding up the final connection process.
Great Process. Good selection of quotes and systems received. Quality suppliers! Overall a great experience. Thank you

Specialised Solar have been an absolute dream to deal with. They were incredibly knowledgeable, trustworthy and I never felt any pressure. The sale rep, George, was always happy for me to touch base and ask a question or 20. He was always available and more than willing to look at various options and designs based on my specific needs. The installation process was quite streamlined and all the paperwork was generally handled on their end (unless I needed to complete something). They offered top of the range items and were extremely clear and upfront about what to expect. I have felt extremely well supported throughout the entire process. I highly recommend Spec Solar!
Seamless customer experience. Was kept well informed from design through to installation and commissioning of the system. A great outcome functionally and aesthetically.

The initial quoting process was done over the phone and internet without the sales staff attending premises but COVID may have had something to do with that. The installers did attend the site for an inspection prior to installation and final quote acceptance.The installation was done on the planned date, the installers were polite courteous and punctual.The customer service team were extremely helpful in arranging final inspection and grid connection after the install including liaising with the power retailer.The whole process was done very quickly and painlessly once quote was accepted.
all seemed easy and helpful, will see how it goes through winter

Specialized Solar was supportive all of the way.Initial salesman was informative and thorough in analyzing our situation and devising a better solution than other quotations which were higher in price and complexity.We had a few issues and they were always responsive and courteous. Installation guys answered many questions with patience.We still have an issue but it is with our power company and Specialized is assisting us with this.

These guys were prompt, professional, knowledgeable, helpful, well resourced the whole way through the process. We have been renovating our whole house and they would have to be on of the easiest contractors to deal with.

Electing for a solar system in November for completion in December was, in retrospect, ambitious on our part.  Specialized Solar provided the system and the sales process went very smoothly, however, circumstances resulted in the installation being deferred to January.The weather in Melbourne in the late spring / early summer period was variable, at best, and not always conducive to people working on an exposed roof.  We get that clearly and understood completely the need to install in January - we also want a great job!By way of compensation for the change (reduction) in the STC's, Specialized Solar absorbed the difference in price, thus, we received our system at the quoted price for last year.  That was pleasing.The installation and commissioning process went very well with no surprises or issues.Whilst we are still getting around the technological aspects of the installed solar system =, we have no hesitation in recommending Specialized Solar to prospective solar users.

Specialized Solar are friendly and reliable.They use top of the range, latest components.They are flexible with the price if you are ready to forgo some of the warranty period.They give a 15 year "power performance guarantee", which I never heard of from the other companies.
Customer service was great. Would have appreciated more communication from the contractor on timelines, etc, but quality of job was very good. Highly recommend
From start to finish you know what is happening next. Any questions you have are answered promptly. Quality service & quality solar installed.

Ben was easy to talk to and provided a prompt quote for a good system and heat pump hot water service.We are in the process of building a new home but his team liaised with our builder and have installed first fixings.The process has been very comfortable

George was the Sales representative and he was brilliant. His knowledge of products and will to have an honest conversation and answer any questions via email or phone call were first class.The installation team will here for 2 days and they did not stop, the work ethic and quality of the work was fantastic.  Friendly and polite and had a few friendly conversations with the team. Wish all experiences with works on my property were as seamless.

The sales/quoting process was extremely prompt. We were assured repeatedly that any information we needed would be supplied. Not understanding much about panels and electricity and technical stuff, we were apprehensive, but we felt the company representatives made every effort to inform us.We appreciated being forewarned that replacement roof tiles would be needed and our sales contact informed us of a tile supplier who sold us the required number of hard-to-source tiles.Installers were polite, tidy and punctual. We were disappointed that the discarded broken tiles were not taken away from the site but we appreciated being informed that the installers wouldn't be taking the rubble away, rather than just leaving an unexpected mess. They even toiled to tuck the remains away, out of sight.They did organize the grid connection and they did make clear that the system would be switched on when inspected which is out of their control.

Not the cheapest nor the most expensive. Specialized Solar took the time to review the aerial map and offer an alternative to having all panels only on one side. Panels and inverter from the same parent company also ticked the box along with long warranties. Specialized are a local company who have been in the industrial for many years with their own team of local installers and electricians.Easy quote back in less than 3 days, took calls on questions. Installed when they said they would and followed up to see if things were right. An outstanding customer service team.Very seamless process from start to finish.Highly recommended.

Specialized Solar was one of three installers recommended by Solar Quotes. The process was easy, and considering Christmas Holidays the system was scheduled and installed on time.Installers showed up on time, and even with the rain we had that day they finished on time and left the installation area clean. The installer had some issues with getting the Consumption meter to hook up via Wifi so that was delayed while they waited for a replacement. Inspector switched the system on nine days later and I've been impressed by it's output so far.Customer service has been great they handled virtually all the paperwork involved.The consumption monitor has been replaced and is now working. We're still working through some readings that are showing in the App.Overall extremely happy with the system, service, and sales staff.

The sales quote was detailed and carried out highly professionally. The installation was carried out on the day arranged. The installers were punctual, very polite and informative and were extremely tidy. I was blown away with their professionalism and customer service skills. It’s not very often I have come across such good workmanship and service. The only aspect of the article overall service provided is that the communication was lacking after the install was complete. Both myself & my partner phoned to find out when the 3rd party inspector would be on-site to sign off on the work. We spoke directly with the salesman and left messages with the after-install contact, but we were not contacted with an update by the company. Thanks s would have been good to have been provided with feedback out of courtesy. That’s the only fault found.

I was impressed with the professional installation, and over a year later I am even more impressed with this product. We have had no problems at all and the system continues to perform flawlessly.Our savings and quality installation make it all worthwhile.Charles

The consultant I dealt with knew his stuff. He answered all my questions and concerns, we went to & fro until we reached the desired outcome. The installers arrived on time, were very polite and tidy , no issues.
Great service good unit . Too early to tell how good it is but appears allg

Very pleased with the service, including the explanation and reason for the final decision afforded, for our particular needs.(Our 6star rated home had a poor design roof system to allow any more panels to be fitted.)On completion, despite being assessed on a cloudy day, I was surprised how it reached 4kw.
Everything when smoothly first they told me what would happen and then they did it.
Specialised Solar have been fantastic! Always keeping me up to date, open about what’s happening and happy to answer any questions we had. Would definitely recommend them!

From initial contact, the quoting and sales process has been excellent, The sales and office staff have been very helpful and obliging  throughout the process and after the installation,The installers completed the job efficiently and were very helpfulJob was started and completed on time,Well done to all the team,

All information about the systems was delivered in a way I understood, sales person was so helpful and friendly he went over and above by lowering the cost and helping fill out rebate forms for the battery.Installers were prompt and reliable and followed through quickly to get it inspected.
The Salesperson visited  uas. He made it wasy to udnerstnad the process. There were a few changes to the initial quote  but everything went through smoothly.

From our first contact with Specialized Solar we could not fault their service and backup. The sales consultant provided the quote quickly with a number of options available and answered any questions promptly, whether it be pricing and rebates, components or installation. The installation team arrived on the nominated day, and early due to forecast rain, and were very competent in their works. Before installing the solar panels they discussed with us the best placement of the panels on the roof and gave an estimation when works would be completed later that day so we could better plan our own day. Even with a few showers, they continued to work and were completed about the estimated time. Everything was cleaned up on site before leaving so no complaints there. The Electrical Inspector was on site the next working day and gave a glowing report of their work citing they were one of the better teams he had inspected. The girls in the office then went to work on the paperwork, etc, and could not be faulted. They led us through the whole process, explaining what was required, what to lookout for regarding paperwork, providing email addresses and phone numbers for support if required and then following up with inquiries as to how the process with the energy providers was progressing and was there anything they could help with.Overall we could not fault our dealings with Specialized Solar and would highly recommend them to anyone considering installing solar panels

The sales and quoting was simple/straight forward. The sales person understood my issues re trees and knew what I needed.Instillation was professional/punctual and considerate.Customer service was excellent. Very helpful with all inquires and problem solving.

Everything was handled very well until the inspector was required to turn the system on. From the time of instillation to the system being operational took 42 days. Not the fault of the supplier but very frustrating for us to have 18 panels on our roof doing nothing for that long period of time.Finally all up and running and we look forward to much lower power bills in the future. Specialized solar tried very hard to speed up the connection process, if that had gone smoothly as it should have we would have had an excellent experience with Specialized Solar.

From start to finish the team at Specialized Solar have been fantastic. All through the process they have been polite, clear, transparent and a pleasure to work with.Their electrical installation team were fantastic even suggesting on the day of installation some reconfiguration to further optimize.They discovered that behind our switchboard was a mess of wires from our original renovation. They cleaned it up at no extra charge. They want to do the job right.Highly recommend.

The salesperson was responsive and helpful and adjusted the system to suit my needs, which were a little unusual (I wanted a higher end inverter and just a few panels so it could be fit within a budget, which didn't make a lot of sense except that it was all to do with timing! anyway, I ended up spending extra to do it properly in one go, but they were helpful nonetheless

Installation was excellent - Installers where polite and punctual and communication spot onThey were very clean and tidy and did not leave any messCustomer service is great and they help with grid connection
Adam discussed the technical issues in detail, the quote was detailed and the cost satisfactory, installation went well and the process of handover was smooth.
Will and his team came at 7:20am and left at 5pm having worked consistently all day. Good safety procedures, pleasant people who cleared up after themselves and left everything tidy.
Awesome customer service through entire process. Knowledgeable sales, good installation and thorough follow up and connecting to grid. Had a really good experience with Specialized Solar

Installers were excellent, although there was a miscommunication on the fact one part was missing and the part ( meter to go in meter box) should have been installed quickly and took another week to install.Took anther 4 days for part to be made operational.

The sales and quoting process was pure business, not a friendly chatty experience.  However, this gave me confidence that I was dealing with a decent, B/S free professional outfit, maybe I annoyed the sales guy because I kept changing my mind as to what I wanted. I started at 5kW and finally settled on a 10.3kW system. The installation team arrived on time and finished as planned the next day. The guys were pleasant and efficient and left the area clean and tidy. They organised the safety inspection and grid connection for the following week (yesterday) and after one sunny day and one cloudy day of operation the system has pumped out 58kWh of clean energy; Fantastic!!

Rough installation. I had cracked and broken tiles, rubbish left on my roof, penetrations through the roof not water tight, sarking tape not sealed correctly. I picked Specialized solar due to their years of experience in the trade but got rough and rushed work from their contractors. Besides the installation their sales and customer service team were great, couldnâ€™t say a bad thing about them. Sad that poor contractors let a company down.

Despite my encouragement that they inspect the site before installation they chose not to. They quoted on a single storey property judged by a google map image. I corrected them that it was 2 storey. Later they indicated it was a flat roof. I again corrected them that it was a gabled roof. They turned up for the installation but left as they said they were not adequately equipped but would return another day. This has given me little confidence in this "recomended"  company but to change or get new quotes is more inconvenience.I now have to wait for them to re-schedule the installation.
Great service from all staff involved from start to finish,especially the ladies from the office,service at its best.Installation went smoothly with no issues at all,tidy,punctual & polite.

Spec solar are true professionals.  They know their stuff and make the whole process easy and streamlined from beginning to end. From the sales team to the installers to the customer service team - all excellent.
Accurate and timely communication. Polite installers, nil issues, thank you

The sales and quoting process went well - was not over sold to, down to earth salesman. Install crew were punctual and polite. Customer service has been very good so far - was contacted the following day for an explanation regarding next steps and gave me expectations on the likely timeframes on each step.
All done via email. Punctual and no hassle efficient installation Very helpful with obtaining government rebate.

All the way through from quotes to installation Specialised Solar have been absolutely excellent to deal with.Sales team was great to work with, prompt responses via phone and email, very knowledgeable about the systems and hardware they offer, and more than happy to get into the nerdy details for those so inclined.Installation team arrived on time, were great to talk to, and the attention to detail on the inverter and panel installation is second to none. Everything lines up, nothing crooked or rushed, and to top it off they left the garage as clean if not cleaner than before they arrived.I would happily recommend Specialised Solar to anybody looking for great price and service on a solar installation.
Explained process well, helped me through the never ending application and were always quick to reply and helpful
not one of the three solar companies ocontacted by solarquotes.com.au but listed as a reputable company by them. installation and service was great
It was great service from you I picked the company because they are tied with Heating and Cooling who are a good well known. Company and their Rep. Knew his subject  and presented well.

Great and friendly sales team that looked after all our questions without hesitationMonitoring app took a while to get activated but working fineJust waiting for our next bill to see any effect on cost
They have been amazingly professional and thorough.At no time did I feel stressed.
Quick turnaround and process very easy from start to finish

We have found in dealing with Specialized Solar that they have been very professional.In addition, they provided excellent customer service and have an extensive knowledge in the various system configurations and panel requirements.From the time they quoted our job, and to the final installation, they provided us with ongoing follow up phone & e-mail communications.This made the process easier for us, as they provided clear timelines & managed the â€œRed Tapeâ€ associated with these type of works.We would recommend them to anyone interested in Solar Panels

I have the most pleasant experience with this solar installation. Prior to installation, Nathanael is very information and professional. He is not â€œpushyâ€ but very courteous throughout the whole transaction. A great asset to the company.Next the team behind the team is just as professional and courteous. Chelsea ( whom I have never met ) is a gem. Whenever she replies her email or answering her calls she is very understanding ,kind, courteous and will bend herself backwards to help solve ant queries or questions. She makes me feel very comfortable talking to her and she is patient. With staff like this, the company will go a long way. Personally I think she deserves a pay rise if she has not have one yet!!The next lady named Gemma (whom I have never had any dealings with before) had just forwarded me an email explaining to me what I will be expecting post installation. In her email she is showing all the attributes of her colleagues. Keep up the good work Gemma.With regards to the installers they were very polite, tidy, knowledgeable about their work and itâ€™s expectations.They were also very punctual and professional in their approach.All in all everything that is done and accomplished with this installation has been a very excellent experience and the last thing that I want to have a fantastic experience is for the solar system to work effectively and efficiently.Finally, would I recommend this company to my relatives and friends? Yes, with no reservations of course!!!

Very happy with the system and the service. A little bit more communication immediately after the install, about the status of the system and how to operate it, would have made the whole experience a perfect 10! Apart from that detail, very happy.

I looked into solar for my home several years ago and found it all to hard to work through, who or what was the best solar and gave up. Something I hear common among friends. Finding SOLARQUOTES web site was the best. It broke down every thing about solar that could be easily understood and gave me a great understanding of the manufactures and models to look for. I have already told friends to use Solarquotes as a great start. Thank you
Overall good experience. Installed promptly, professionally. Had to do a little chasing to get access to the app, but happy now this all done. Would (and have) recommended to others.
Specialised Solar are a good company to deal with. Efficient installation and all forms and paperwork were provided post install. I'd recommend them.

Kept getting pushed back due to weather (I get it, can't control that), however the next available installation was always weeks later. Didn't feel like I was a priority. Chelsea who was the contact was lovely though and did her best to make me feel like a valued customer. Install team didn't call before either of the visits.

My Husband and I could not have been anymore happier with this company, everyone was so helpful and so professional, and the four guys that were here at our house so polite and professional and when they left everything was clean and tidy, they even trimmed a tree for us, canâ€™t sing this companies praises enough. 5 stars!

We were delighted with the professionalism and support given by the sales staff, office administration and the installers. We would highly recommend this company to any prospective solar purchasers.Thank you so much for youe excellent service.

Spec Solar were great to work with. Anthony Igmen was the BDM who managed the process for me, and was very knowledgeable about what they could offer, configuration, time frames, and was willing to work with me to get the price down, based on our needs, and other offers.
The team kept me informed throughout the process and even though initial inverter was faulty, they were back within a few days with replacement.
The person who came to see us was very personable, not pushy, explained everything in plain english so we could understand it easily.

My experience with Specialized Solar Solutions has been positive all the way through from the initial quoting process with Anthony to installation with Joel and his team.There has been good communication and the necessary paperwork has been processed quickly.We're still waiting on Ausnet to do the meter but the system is working above our expectations.

Great company to deal with. After a few early hiccups at the quote stage with emails going astray everything else went very smoothly.Really good communications and everything from install, inspection, paperwork, meter config happened as desired.

Good communication, fast responses by Specialized Solar. Initial quoted panel distribution in 2 strings (16/6) not suitable for inverter, needed to be altered on installation date (12/10). Slight issue with electric installers not setting up wireless monitoring correctly, needed to contact Inverter manufacturer to resolve issue.

Specialized Solar Solutions were good to deal with and an accidentally broken skylight was replaced quickly. They listened and made good suggestions about what we could do (inverter location and panel arrangement options) when other potential suppliers didn't or wouldn't (in order to make the install easy for them).
Used company In the past. Knowledgeable people. they don't over sell.Highly recommended.

Charles and the team were very helpful and informative all the way through to post installation. They were always happy to answer all our questions and provide information to help us make a well informed decision. Installation was seamless and tidy.Inspection took 4 weeks but I am led to believe that is because of our rural location. Once done paperwork was filed promptly and submitted to our power company.So far we have halved our electricity bill and we are looking forward to receiving a further reduction to our bill once AGL get round to remotely reconfiguring our meter which can take up to 4 weeks!!

Installation was fantastic. Fast and on time.Price seems reasonable in the average figure. Not the most expensive but definitely not the cheapest.The one and only downside was it took weeks to get Inverter admin password.if you decide to go with SpecSolar, make sure that you get the admin password straight from installer on the installation day.The sales person did his best to help. Everything else is brilliant.
The Process was easier than I expected. The installers were on time and got the job completed quicker than expected. Overall I am very satisfied
So far, very good experience. The inspector said that it was a very high quality installation. Still waiting for paperwork to claim Vic solar rebate.

Since purchasing our system in April 2017, we have generated 5.82 Mw of power which should please any greenie.  We brought the top of the line system because as an electrical engineer I was aware of the shortcomings of the cheaper systems and I wanted a guarantee the panel produce at least 85% of their rated power in 20 years time.  Many early and cheaper systems would be flat out meeting that requirement in 5 to 7 years.In summer when we operate a cooling system for most of the day and evening, typically we don't have to pay for any electricity from 6:30 in the morning through to 6:15 at night.  In Jan 2018 we imported 183 kw, exported 384 kw and self consumed 228 kw.In winter we use very little electric heating (gas or coonara main heat sources), typically we don't have to pay for electricity from 8:30 in the morning to 4:00 in the afternoon.In Jun 2018 we imported 180 kw, exported 148 kw and self consumed 89 kw.Our last electricity bill (for 3 people) from 5th Jan to 6th Apr was $116.  That included $118 for supply charge and $122 credit from the feed in tariff and a $45 discount for paying by the due date.  Frankly, I can live with only paying $1.00 per day for electricity.
Only had system for 2 weeks , not yet synced with meter/elec co so no idea how good it is or quality of system

Anthony has been fantastic and has answered every question possible, Everything has been installed and we are working through some final adjustments to maximise power. Could not be happier just ready to sit back and see what the system is going to do.As an FYI i have 10.5kw of panels and an 8kw inverter split over 2 strings East and West

It seems there the salesman that contacted me for quotes don't really know a lot about there products and installation as none of them could work out the 3 phase power affect if any on the system. I have 3 phase.

Take up the offer of three quotes, discuss any issues with Solar Quotes as they are helpful and then question your installer and take up their offer of being at the end of the phone to deal with issues or questions. Our experience was a good one, through dealing with Solar Quotes through to Specialised Solar and the follow up after installation to ensure everything was going well and no more questions to be answered.
It's still early days but so far so good
They were great at communicating what was happening and reworking their schedule around terrible weather.

Excellent advice from solarquotes.com.au website . By far the best source of information that I found, followed up with excellent advice from their solar quotes people and a provider who knew what they were on about, listened to my needs and changed their quoted system to better suit my needs. The installers consulted me fully on the day resulting in a neat professional installation and excellent system.
We are very happy with our system
Fantastic experience all round. Very easy  company to deal with. Very nice and friendly salesperson.

On time for appointments, salesman was patient and his explanations of how the system worked was excellent. A well organised installing crew and their workmanship was first class, everything plum and neatly installed.

Installers were very professional in their approach, suggested some minor changes that benefited the install and expected performance. Install was performed in a timely manner with a very good clean up afterwards. Would recommend the install team very highly.
While the installation seems to have gone OK the customer service and assistance ended as soon as the money had been paid.Still waiting for a hand over meeting with any instruction and advise.
I can't rate the operation because while the unit has been installed I'm waiting forPower or to do whatever it is they have to do
All the sales were very professional and knowledgable in solar energy. We chose this company because they offer best value system and top quality inverter for our shaded roof.
Will know more when everything is up and running. Installers very polite and professional.I was still disappointed nobody from the Latrobe Valley is listed with you.
There was a lot to learn/absorb but i quite enjoyed doing some home work

There were a few hiccups along the way, like I wasn't given the break-down for costs of each panels and cost for workmanship but rather an overall lump-sum. That said, overall I still reckon it's reasonable for the quote that I was given. I only rate Good for Quality of System (even though I have gone for panels that are at the higher end of the market) as it's still the early stage after the installation, I am yet to see the full benefits/potential. I would recommend SSS to anyone if they are being recommended as a potential installer. Speak to them and make up your mind.
Excellent salesman did a great job getting the price right, good installation team, clean and tidy, very happy that everything went so smoothly.
The system is not yet installed as we are constructing a new house. Once fitted, later in the year, I will have a better understanding of their overall service.

Chosing a solar installer for us had become a long and tortuous process before we came across Specialised Solar Solutions. Business Development Manager Anthony took us through every aspect of our installation, and was only too willing to answer any questions we had, or do further research if he didn't know the answer. He was constantly honest with us (a rarity these days) and there was no nasty surprises. We now have a solar system that is exceeding our expectations.

We chose to install solar edge inverter and have power optimizers so we could monitor the daily use and individual panels.This has been a disaster as the site they send me to is always down so i cant register.This has nothing to do with the installer but it it is why we choose the more expensive system.Follow up on 18/3/2017:This is a follow up to my previous post, as i cant change what has been followed up with.Anthony from Specialised Solar Solutions rang me after he found out about our issues with solaredge.and had the issue resolved within 1/2 an hour.I failed to mention the installation was done with great guy's who cleaned up after themselves. Also as we have a newborn they made as little noise as possible when she was asleep.THE WHOLE PROCESS FROM GETTING THE 3 QUOTES UNTIL INSTALLATION WAS FANTASTIC.

We went for what we thought was the best balance of quality, performance and budget... figuring you get what you pay for.The experience was very good and system performance is great.I've compared both production and monitoring results with family and friends who also have 5kW solar systems and they have envious eyes.I'm happy to recommend these guys and this product without reservation.

The sales guy Anthony is great, helped me a lot with the Quote, system, design, etc, nice chap.But he too was very upset and disappointed when he found out  about my experience.1st as I drive up the driveway, I notice that my garden hose was unclip and lying  on the grass, not where I usually clip it in the tap and hold against the wall,2nd, my recycling BIN was full of all the wrappings of solar panels .plastics bags,and all the other rubbish associated to installing the system.3rd,all the concrete drilling and all dirt ,work mess,wires cutting,etc, associated with installing the system,left on the floor all over for me to clean.4th My biggest frustration was to find that the panels was design to have a full 9 STRAIGHT PANELS ORIENTATION right on the top pitch of the roof,WHICH WAS to give greater exposure to the sun,and therefore greater return on my investment but instead its was a different configuration install,and the excuse was that it was EASIER TO DO IT THAT WAY???? THAT ONE really peed me off....4th the monitoring system was not installed properly even thought they have done these so many times,where was the QC.The electrician had to come back to reverse the cable ,as all the data was reversed on the readings.5th the inspector has to fit another missing cable,as my inverter was reading low voltage and the electrician obviously according to him missed that one...6th That I had to sit down, waist my time to type all this, where all I wanted was what I paid for...NO wonder Australia is falling in a big hole, DOES ANYBODY REALLY CARE???????Hope finally this is of some help for someone else,They call themselves SPECIALIZED SOLAR ??????????????

Partial installation at the moment. Solar panel array has been installed and in a few months the inverter and connection shall be finalised. So as yet I'm not sure how well / efficient the system will function.I have confidence in the company to deliver the best possible configuration for 3 phase, hybrid ready system.

We chose the best balance between budget, features and quality.  Spec Solar had that.  Friendly helpful service made it a very pleasant experience.  Overall we were very happy and we would recommend them without hesitation.

The installation went smoothly and on time. However, we had an issue with 5 of our 14 panels not producing power. Rang our contact who organised the installer to come around and check the installation, they analysed the problem and took some information back to the office to seek a resolution. Resolution was applied within a couple of days and now the system is performing brilliantly. Customer service and willingness to help is fantastic, always polite and quick to respond. We would recommend Specialized Solar to anyone else seeking to install a system.
Too early to tell. Would wait at least 6 months before feedback
Excellent service from start to finish.

We decided to go with a very good system but not the top-of-the-range system offered by another company at greater cost. The experience of having 3 different quotes for 3 similar but not exactly the same systems was interesting and an excellent learning experience. All company reps clearly had an excellent knowledge of their systems and it was difficult making a choice about which was best for us.
Completely professional, reliable, timely and polite
They didn't check the job properly before starting so there were holdups and didn't do what was agreed on and had to redo work.
Job is still not complete. Installed 2weeks ago and still not back to finish up.
